Privately pushed gpu/plane-field-throughput, commit 729862f8eda5f585771984e945f5185373e9ec86 (now 3c790ef).

  • Fused cuTile fields: 12–22% less execution time, preserving full complex128 precision.
  • Cached sampling: 7.12× / 7.74× versus the strongest prepared Rust CPU baseline; actual Python calls achieve 6.43× / 7.49×, including transfers.
  • Added Hermitian matrix products for coefficient pullbacks using the same resident operator.

The sampling cases require 384 MiB / 1.5 GiB and approximately 138 / 86 Python applications to amortize cold setup. Adjoint speedups are 9.49× / 10.81× against cached CPU products only; a fused CPU adjoint was not benchmarked.

Verified: just check, all-feature Clippy, 9 Rust GPU tests, 10 Python GPU tests, and portable feature exclusion. CPU numerical code is unchanged; the original 527 performance gates were not rerun. No geometry GPU pullback or automatic framework GPU routing was added.

Evidence: qualification, sampling report.

Integration needs: cherry-pick, reconcile docs/status.md, regenerate the API catalog with just docs. Main and PR state are unchanged. Remove the isolated remote worktree after integration.
